records.source: Which phases a run without its own phase list runs, in the order spaCR runs them, as 'stitch,phenotype,objects,decode,ph_segment,ph_measure,ph_masks,merge,aggregate'. With it, spacr-run ops runs the phenotype, merge and aggregate phases from the settings file alone, so the file reproduces the run. A phase spaCR does not know is refused before anything runs. Empty runs stitch, phenotype, objects and decode, as before. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: Hvaða fasa keyrsla án eigin fasalista keyrir, í þeirri röð sem spaCR keyrir þá, til dæmis 'stitch,phenotype,objects,decode,ph_segment,ph_measure,ph_masks,merge,aggregate'. Með henni keyrir spacr-run ops fasana phenotype, merge og aggregate eingöngu út frá stillingaskránni, svo skráin endurskapar keyrsluna. Fasa sem spaCR þekkir ekki er hafnað áður en nokkuð keyrir. Tómt keyrir stitch, phenotype, objects og decode, eins og áður. Sjálfgefið None. Alfa.
